entry_state: Finance methods preserve current measurement,new presentation and old OCI origins separately. The claims process then shows how a joint law changes nonlinear treaty recovery despite identical marginals. Chain-ladder factors give point reserve148 but do not determine a payment law. Two-stage resampling distinguishes fitted means from process payments and preserves shared-fit dependence;the sparse-data and failed-draw discussion has begun.
exit_state: Reserving methods retain failed draws,process-family choices,conditioning information and reserve-centering conventions. The risk-measure discussion separates additional compensation from expected payment,derives atom-aware expected shortfall and nonnegative distortion weights,and identifies source-version formula errors with counterexamples. A new information tree now distinguishes today's variance from future conditional risk;its general inequalities continue next.
findings: The sparse triangle retains reserve148 while returning unresolved dispersion;zero fitted dispersion is not deterministic future payment. Failed probability mass is neither zero payment nor silently resampled success.
The manuscript confines its negative-mean,centering and transform-formula criticisms to inspected versions and derived counterexamples. It does not infer what unavailable execution code did.
Conditional-on-diagonal and conditional-on-full-triangle prediction errors have different targets. A backward law is not implied by forward moments or reciprocal-factor convenience.
Expected shortfall retains exactly the required atom at the cutoff. A cumulative coverage probability is distinguished from an exact quantile-equivalent level.
The information tree is legible at normal resolution and shows news arriving before cash. No new confirmed local defect.
